items.title: Josiah "Cie" Frazier Interview, 1961-02-02
items.q: Me and Alfred used to alternate with the duplex snare drum, you see. We alternate on parades.

ctx.x: You say you used to play these parades. You use the same drum as you've got here now?

Well, not this snare drum. I had another black. They both live. I had a black wood shell drum, similar to one like Happy Youth. And lots of parades in the later years, I used to use the same drum on his trapania used. Used to call it duplex snare drum. Oh, duplex. Me and Alfred used to alternate with the duplex snare drum, you see. We alternate on parades. If I go play a parade, he wouldn't be working with it. I get the snare drum from him.
Is that the one Alfred Williams got now, or is that a different one?

items.title: Josiah 'Cie' Frazier Interview, 1972-01-19
items.q: Alfred Williams on drums... Sam Morgan on trumpet... That's how we line them up.

ctx.x: Who played Dronsfield Morgan's band most of the time?
